Android TV Family File Library - Plain Text Document
====================================================

This is a high-legibility plain text document intended for the 28sp TV viewer.
Navigation is optimized for D-pad directional controls:
- Up/Down: Smooth vertical line scrolling
- Left/Right: Page jump scrolling
- Center/OK: Toggle controls overlay
- Back: Return to shelf view

Features validated:
1. 5% overscan margins compliance (48dp H, 27dp V)
2. Clean word-wrapping without horizontal truncation
3. UTF-8 international characters rendering
